verdict.rationale: Publishing delegated-filing rules (authorization forms, intermediary roles, which signatures must stay personal) is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt probes that returned HTTP 403, and neither says anything about delegated access. Nothing in the pack shows the capability, so the verdict is none; confidence is low because the gap reflects blocked access rather than a confirmed absence.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
